summary: V50.z320 Codici Promozionali — FRONTEND smoke test. Super-admin (/admin/promo-codes) flow works end-to-end: header 'Codici Promozionali' + testID promo-add render, create modal (promo-create-modal) with promo-code-name / promo-benefit-free_months / promo-value / promo-expires (mask GG/MM/AAAA works: '31122099' → '31/12/2099') / promo-uses-n / promo-max-uses / promo-create-save all functional, row testID promo-row-TESTUI86367 appears with 'Attivo · 1 mese gratuito · 0 / 5 · scade 31/12/2099'. Detail modal shows Stato/Utilizzi/Scadenza labels, promo-toggle-active, 'Nessun utilizzo finora.', promo-delete, promo-detail-close. Toggle off correctly changes badge to 'Disattivato'. /master hub shows testID hub-admin-promo tile for super-admin. CRITICAL BLOCKER: redeem-side flow for the demo user is COMPLETELY BROKEN — /impostazioni?section=billing renders 'Errore modulo — profile: Cannot convert undefined or null to object' (JS 'TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object at Object.values ... at SetupEntryCard'), so promo-redeem-card / promo-code-input / promo-code-apply / promo-code-success / promo-code-error / promo-my-<CODE> could NOT be exercised. As a result the '1/5 usage', 'demo@advisoros.it in Chi l'ha usato' and final delete-via-window.confirm assertions could NOT be validated. Backend endpoints per handoff are green in pytest so the bug is 100% frontend-side in the Impostazioni billing section. Onboarding step (assistant_setup_done=false → promo-step) NOT tested: demo user is stuck on /tour and the Salta button did not advance (tour is empty except for a 'Ricomincia dal principio' link), same billing-section error appears embedded in tour flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Route /impostazioni?section=billing throws 'Errore modulo — profile: Cannot convert undefined or null to object'. Console: 'TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object at Object.values (<anonymous>) at SetupEntryCard'. Blocks the entire PromoRedeemCard so normal users cannot redeem promo codes. Reference: SetupEntryCard component in the billing section (likely /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/impostazioni.tsx or a sub-module fetching profile/subscription data where Object.values(profile.something) is called before the object is loaded).

After login, demo@advisoros.it is routed to /tour but the tour appears blank (only 'Silenzia / Salta' header + 'Ricomincia dal principio' link visible). Salta button does not advance the tour. Same 'SetupEntryCard' error is thrown from inside the tour, suggesting the tour reuses the broken billing/profile card. Prevents reaching the promo-step (V50.z320 onboarding step) at all.

action_items: URGENT: Fix the 'SetupEntryCard' component (Impostazioni › Abbonamento e Pagamenti). The Object.values() call is receiving null/undefined — guard with `Object.values(x || {})` or wait for data load state. This bug blocks ALL of the following: promo code redemption (V50.z320), subscription status view, onboarding tour completion for demo user.

After the SetupEntryCard fix, re-run the FRONTEND playbook to validate: redeem, re-redeem (409 → promo-code-error 'Hai già utilizzato questo codice'), invalid (404 → promo-code-error 'Codice non valido'), promo-my-<CODE> history line, super-admin detail-modal '1 / 5' + demo@advisoros.it in 'Chi l'ha usato', delete-via-window.confirm.
Consider wrapping promo-delete button in a persistent footer within PromoDetailModal so it stays clickable on small viewports.

Onboarding promo-step: retest after the tour SetupEntryCard fix. The current tour is blank for demo user, so promo-step cannot be reached even after resetting user_settings.assistant_setup_done=false.

Clean up leftover TESTUI86367 code (currently disabled, 0/5 uses) — DELETE from mongo `db.promo_codes.deleteMany({code:{$regex:'^TESTUI'}})`. Direct DELETE via /api/admin/promo-codes/{id} returned 403 for owner test@dalpastro.it (only super-admin? confirm route auth).
critical_code_review_comments: PromoDetailModal (/app/frontend/app/admin/promo-codes.tsx L200-247) has promo-delete rendered AFTER the redemptions ScrollView but not sticky — on small screens with any redemptions rendered it can scroll off-viewport. Move outside the ScrollView or make the sheet layout flex-column with a fixed action row.

The 'Object.values(x)' bug in SetupEntryCard shows a systemic issue: components rely on API data being present immediately. Adopt a consistent loading state + null-safe destructuring pattern across the profile/billing module.

PromoCodeField error path shows the raw error message from api() (e?.message) — good UX for '409 Hai già utilizzato questo codice' / '404 Codice non valido' provided backend returns those exact detail strings. Confirm backend detail() strings match the assertions in the review request.

seed_data_creation: Created promo code TESTUI86367 (free_months=1, max_uses=5, expires 31/12/2099). Currently in 'disabled' state, 0/5 uses. Manual DELETE via API returned 403 for owner — main agent should remove via mongo or a super-admin token.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login helper must (1) clear localStorage+sessionStorage first (there's a device-registered QuickUnlockCard interfering otherwise), (2) click auth-tab-login then fill auth-email-input/auth-password-input via page.keyboard.type (page.fill was flaky on 1/3 attempts), (3) after auth-submit-button wait up to 15s for URL != /login, (4) if landed on /tour, try clicking text='Salta' — but for demo user the tour is currently broken (SetupEntryCard error) so Salta is a no-op; force navigation via router replace or set localStorage.setItem('onboarding_done_<user_id>','1') then goto direct route. Token is stored in localStorage under key 'auth_token_v1'. Admin promo-codes page and /master hub work fine. The only real blocker for the V50.z320 UI test is the SetupEntryCard error in /impostazioni?section=billing.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: 1) Login as demo@advisoros.it/Demo1234!. 2) Navigate to /impostazioni?section=billing (or tap Impostazioni › 'Abbonamento e Pagamenti'). 3) Observe 'Errore modulo — profile: Cannot convert undefined or null to object' error card, ErrorBoundary catches: 'TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object at Object.values (<anonymous>) at SetupEntryCard'. Root cause: SetupEntryCard component calls Object.values() on a profile/subscription field that is null/undefined during first render (before fetch resolves) or in the case demo user has no subscription set. Mitigation: guard the call — `Object.values(subscription?.some_field ?? {})` — or gate rendering behind `if (!data) return <Skeleton />`. This bug is independent of the V50.z320 feature but blocks its user-visible flow entirely.
